ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text:
A plastic snap-together cube has a protruding snap on one side and receptacle holes on the other five sides as shown.  What is the smallest number of these cubes that can be snapped together so that only receptacle holes are showing?

ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: What is drawn in the figure is a plastic interlocking cube. The upper surface of the cube has a black cylindrical protruding snap; the visible front face and right side face each have a circular or elliptical receptacle hole. The problem statement says that the other five faces are all receptacle holes, so each small cube has exactly 1 protruding snap and 5 holes. Reasoning: To make only receptacle holes show on the outside, each cube's only protruding snap must be inserted into another cube's hole and cannot be exposed on the outside. Regard each cube as a point, and regard which adjacent cube its snap is inserted into as a directed edge, then each point must have 1 outgoing edge. Two snaps cannot be hidden at the same time between one pair of adjacent faces, because if both sides of the same pair of contacting faces are protruding snaps, a snap-into-hole connection cannot be formed. If there are fewer than 4 cubes: 1 cube cannot hide its own snap; 2 cubes would require the two cubes to insert into each other on the same contacting face, forming an impossible bidirectional connection; if 3 cubes all have to have each snap hidden, then a 2-cycle or 3-cycle must appear. A 2-cycle is likewise impossible, and a 3-cycle requires three unit cubes to be pairwise face-adjacent to form a triangle, but unit cubes in a cubic lattice cannot form this kind of face-adjacent triangle. 4 cubes can do it: arrange them into a 2×2 square cyclic adjacency structure, and make the four snaps be inserted one after another along this square cycle into the next cube's hole. In this way all protruding snaps are hidden internally, and all exposed faces are faces with holes. Therefore at least 4 cubes are needed.

raw_record.question_text: A plastic snap-together cube has a protruding snap on one side and receptacle holes on the other five sides as shown. What is the smallest number of these cubes that can be snapped together so that only receptacle holes are showing?

method.method_draft: First read the image: the cube drawing shows a single protruding cylindrical snap on one face, while the visible side faces have circular/oval receptacle holes; the text confirms that each cube has exactly one protruding snap and holes on the other five faces. Model each cube as a vertex with one required outgoing connection: its snap must point into a hole on an adjacent cube, otherwise a protrusion would show. A connection cannot hide two snaps at once, since the same shared face-pair cannot have protrusions from both cubes and still be a snap-into-hole joint. For fewer than 4 cubes, every cube needing to hide its one snap would force a directed cycle: 1 cube is impossible, 2 cubes would need an impossible mutual two-way snap, and 3 cubes would need either an impossible 2-cycle or a triangular face-adjacency cycle, which unit cubes cannot form in the cubic grid. Then give a construction with 4 cubes: place them in a 2-by-2 square arrangement and orient the four snaps cyclically around the square, so each cube’s snap goes into the next cube’s hole. All protrusions are internal, and every exposed face is one of the receptacle-hole faces, so the minimum is 4.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中画的是一个塑料拼接立方体。立方体的上表面有一个黑色圆柱状的突出 snap；可见的正面和右侧面各有一个圆形或椭圆形的 receptacle hole。题干说明其余五个面都是 receptacle holes，因此每个小方块恰好有 1 个突出的 snap 和 5 个孔。

推理：要让外面只显示 receptacle holes，每个方块唯一的突出 snap 都必须插入另一个方块的孔中，不能暴露在外。把每个方块看成一个点，把它的 snap 插入哪个相邻方块看成一条有向边，则每个点都必须有 1 条出边。一个相邻面之间不能同时隐藏两个 snap，因为同一对接触面若两边都是突出 snap，就不能形成 snap-into-hole 的连接。

若少于 4 个方块：1 个方块不可能隐藏自己的 snap；2 个方块会要求两个方块互相在同一接触面上插入，形成不可能的双向连接；3 个方块若每个 snap 都要被隐藏，就必须出现 2-cycle 或 3-cycle。2-cycle 同样不可能，而 3-cycle 要求三个单位立方体两两按面相邻形成三角形，但单位立方体在立方格中不能形成这种面相邻三角形。

4 个方块可以做到：把它们排成一个 2×2 的正方形环形相邻结构，并让四个 snap 依次沿着这个正方形循环插入下一个方块的孔中。这样所有突出的 snap 都在内部被隐藏，所有外露面都是带孔的面。因此最少需要 4 个方块。
